long_biography.plain_text:
The Mattei Foundation's support for cardiovascular care has focused on turning clinical research into practical prevention. As trustee, James Scott Mattei helped sustain a Charlotte chronic-disease institute and broaden its programs for patients at risk. The work added a public-health dimension to his investment and foundation responsibilities.

Education and culture form another part of that giving. Foundation support helped create an upper-school library and media center designed for research, digital production and collaborative learning. Current foundation filings also document continued charitable grant-making under Mattei's trusteeship. His community work has included board service with local arts and educational organizations.
